generated_response: Liquidity refers to the ability of an asset or financial instrument to be converted into cash quickly and without significant additional cost or delay. In other words, it measures the ease with which an asset can be exchanged for cash. Liquidity is important because it determines the value of assets and their potential investment opportunities. A high level of liquidity means that an asset is easy to sell quickly at a reasonable price, which makes it more attractive to investors looking for income or speculation.
